title: Epipelagic Point
body_html:
Epipelagic Point

Let \(G\) be a reductive group over a \(p\)-adic field \(k\), and let \(x\) lie in the apartment \(A(S,k)\) for a maximal \(k\)-split torus \(S\). For \(x\), let \(r(x)\) be the smallest positive affine-root value at \(x\), and let \(\mathbf g_{x,r}^\vee\) be the dual of the Moy-Prasad graded piece \(\mathbf g_{x,r}/\mathbf g_{x,r+}\).

For an integer \(m\) prime to \(p\), the point \(x\) is an epipelagic point of order \(m\) if \[ r(x)=1/m \] and \(\mathbf g_{x,1/m}^\vee\) contains a stable vector for the reductive quotient \(G_x\).
